verdict.rationale: The evidence pack offers only glancing support: there are titles for a Tax Module and a Sales Channel Module (which could back separate storefronts), plus storefront development guides, but no content describing international selling. A community comment (an older HN thread) notes weak internationalization, with a single title/description string per product and no easy localization across regions. missing for 10: multi-currency pricing evidence, translation/localization support, duties handling, localized storefront documentation, independent corroboration.
